**Best ultra-budget options:**

- **Asus Vivobook S14** (14", AMD Ryzen 5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) — from **£499** in UK

**Gaming laptops:**
- **HP Victus 15.6" FHD Gaming** (8GB RAM, 512GB SSD) — **$703** at Best Buy (Save $421.99)
- **Lenovo LOQ** (AMD Ryzen 5, RTX 4050, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) — **$949.99** at Best Buy (Save $100)

## Premium Laptops (Over $1,000 / £1,000)

**Apple MacBook deals:**
- **MacBook Air M4** (13", 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) — **$999** at Best Buy (Save $200)
- **MacBook Air M5** (13", 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) — **£989** in UK (Save £100)
- **MacBook Pro M5** (14", 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) — from **£1,279** in UK (was £1,523)

**High-performance Windows:**
- **HP Omen 16** (AMD Ryzen 9, RTX 5060, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD) — **$1,549.99** at Best Buy (Save $670)
- **Asus Zenbook S 16** (AMD Ryzen AI 9, 16" OLED, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD) — **$1,349.99** at Best Buy (Save $150)
- **Asus Vivobook S 16** (Intel Core Ultra 7, 16" OLED, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD) — **$1,299.99** at Newegg (Save $300)

## India-Specific Deals (Flipkart Sale 2026)

If you're in India, the **Flipkart Sasa Lele Sale** (starting May 9, 2026) offers:
- **Motobook 60 OLED** — **₹47,490** (49% off, save ₹46,200)
- **Samsung Galaxy Book 4 Core i7** — **₹58,990** (34% off)
- **Asus Vivobook 14** — **₹58,990** (37% off)

*Additional 10% off with SBI credit cards + exchange offers available*

## Tips for Finding the Best Deals

1. **Compare multiple retailers** — Prices vary significantly between Amazon, Best Buy, Newegg, Staples, and direct manufacturer sites
2. **Check for student discounts** — Asus offers 15% off direct purchases for students
3. **Look for voucher codes** — Dell frequently has active online discount codes
4. **Consider open-box or recertified** — Save big on premium models (e.g., Open-box XPG Xenia Xe with 1TB SSD for $699.50, save $700)
5. **Time your purchase** — Major sales events in May (summer sales) and January (clearance) often offer the deepest discounts on previous-year models
